presentation.label: SILENT PAD+TRIG
presentation.summary: Two checkboxes: with SILENT PAD+TRIG, pads and TRIG keys select their track silently outside recording; with SILENT PAD LIVEREC, pads stay silent in LIVE RECORDING. FUNC + pad plays (and records), and aftertouch still works.
presentation.overview: Silent Pad+Trig Settings adds two checkboxes to GLOBAL > CONTROL > SEQUENCER CONFIG, after AUTO TRK SWITCH. SILENT PAD+TRIG covers every state but LIVE and STEP RECORDING: a pad or TRIG key 1-12 press selects its track and stays silent, with no MIDI note. SILENT PAD LIVEREC covers LIVE RECORDING: a pad press selects its track silently and records nothing, while TRIG keys play and record as stock. Either way, hold FUNC and press a pad to play it at the pad's own velocity, which in LIVE RECORDING also records. STEP RECORDING is stock. Aftertouch is untouched, so a held pad modulates its track without sounding it. Both default to unchecked, are kept per GLOBAL slot and are saved with the project.
highlights: Tap pads to pick tracks without hearing them, while editing or while live recording, each switched on its own.
FUNC + pad plays and records, at the pad's own velocity.
Hold a pad down to modulate its sound with aftertouch, silently.
Two checkboxes per GLOBAL slot, kept through a power cycle; unchecked is stock.
usage: Use a build containing Silent Pad+Trig Settings. Open the GLOBAL menu, then CONTROL > SEQUENCER CONFIG. After AUTO TRK SWITCH are SILENT PAD+TRIG and SILENT PAD LIVEREC; check either with YES or LEFT/RIGHT.

With SILENT PAD+TRIG checked and the sequencer stopped, tap the SD pad: it makes no sound and the SD track is selected. Hold FUNC and tap SD to hear it at the pad's own velocity. TRIG 5 selects track 5 silently.

With SILENT PAD LIVEREC checked, press RECORD + PLAY for LIVE RECORDING: plain pad taps stay silent and record nothing; hold FUNC and tap a pad to play and record it. Uncheck both to get stock behaviour everywhere.

access.location: GLOBAL > CONTROL > SEQUENCER CONFIG: SILENT PAD+TRIG and SILENT PAD LIVEREC, after AUTO TRK SWITCH.
steps: Open the GLOBAL menu and choose CONTROL, then SEQUENCER CONFIG.
Move to SILENT PAD+TRIG or SILENT PAD LIVEREC, just after AUTO TRK SWITCH, and press YES (or RIGHT) to check it.

controls.name: SILENT PAD+TRIG
controls.doc: Checkbox in GLOBAL > CONTROL > SEQUENCER CONFIG, after AUTO TRK SWITCH. YES toggles it, RIGHT checks, LEFT unchecks. Checked: outside LIVE and STEP RECORDING, pads and TRIG keys 1-12 select their track silently. Kept per GLOBAL slot.

controls.name: SILENT PAD LIVEREC
controls.doc: Checkbox after SILENT PAD+TRIG. YES toggles it, RIGHT checks, LEFT unchecks. Checked: in LIVE RECORDING, pads select their track silently and record nothing; TRIG keys still play and record. Kept per GLOBAL slot.

controls.name: FUNC + pad
controls.doc: Where a checked setting applies, plays the pad's track at the strike's velocity, or the fixed velocity with FIX on (stock FUNC + pad uses the TRIG page's VEL); records it in LIVE RECORDING; selects the track only if AUTO TRK SWITCH is checked, as stock.

controls.name: Pad held down
controls.doc: Aftertouch, as stock: modulates the track's AFTERTOUCH destinations and sends MIDI poly pressure, also after a silent press.

limitations: Built for OS 1.74 only, with core-ar2 0.3.
0.5.0 (PS07) and 0.5.1 (PS08) ran on a unit: both settings worked as intended and the renamed row fits, as reported. MIDI out and STEP REC not yet tested on a unit.
FUNC + TRIG 1-12 plays nothing, as on stock: use FUNC + pad to hear a track.
A silent press passes its aftertouch on, so MIDI out can carry poly pressure with no note-on before it.
TRIG 13 (the FX track), the SOUND BROWSER's pad audition and pads with a menu open are silent too; FUNC + pad plays.
RTRG + pad selects silently; FUNC + RTRG also toggles the metronome click, as on stock, so it is not a clean way to roll.
A unit that ran 0.4.x starts 0.5.x with both rows unchecked: the storage layout changed, so the old setting is not carried over. 0.5.0's settings carry over to 0.5.1.
A GLOBAL slot saved without a setting, or received as Global SysEx, loads it unchecked.
LIVE RECORDING counts only while the sequencer runs; a paused LIVE REC follows SILENT PAD+TRIG.

Like stock's SEQUENCER CONFIG rows, a changed row is saved when you leave the menu: power off straight from SEQUENCER CONFIG and the change is lost (seen on a unit, with KIT RELOAD ON CHG behaving the same).

claims: ui:GLOBAL > CONTROL > SEQUENCER CONFIG row after AUTO TRK SWITCH

load.display: None in the audio path: a few compares per pad or TRIG key press
load.conditions: Static: the sites are in KeyboardView's pad and TRIG key handlers, their shared play routine and the SEQUENCER CONFIG menu's constructor; each press reads the record state and one storage bit. Nothing is added to the audio, sequencer or tick paths. Not a measurement.

hardware.summary: npp1993 (the author) flashed PS07 (0.5.0) and PS08 (0.5.1) on an Analog Rytm MKII, OS 1.74 with core-ar2 0.3, and reports: both rows show in SEQUENCER CONFIG; SILENT PAD+TRIG silences pads unless FUNC is held; SILENT PAD LIVEREC lays down no trigs from plain pad presses in LIVE REC while FUNC + pad plays and records and TRIG keys stay stock; the 0.5.1 label fits; a changed row is saved on leaving the menu, as stock KIT RELOAD ON CHG is.
limitations: Results are as reported by the author, not itemized measurements; duration not recorded.
PS07 carried the functional tests; PS08 (0.5.1, the same code with the second row relabelled) was checked for the label and saving.
MIDI out, STEP REC, RTRG + pad, the SOUND BROWSER, AUTO TRK SWITCH off, per-slot settings on 0.5.x and loading a checked project on stock 1.74 were not tested on a unit.
Tested SysEx: PS07 eae28e8ff6ae9f29a9d608c0fbe3985804779b42fd96d33d1e4c1d97934cae99, PS08 ff7c4cf3ca61f3c461a16a416cb4515e0d44727216f688ab965785bdbd5343d4; firmware was not read back from the device.

tests.summary: Emulator (rytm-emu c5732f0, OS 1.74, builds PS07 and, for the renamed row, PS08), against stock from matched snapshots with neither, each and both settings: both unchecked matches stock exactly; SILENT PAD+TRIG silences pads and TRIG 1-12 outside LIVE and STEP REC, SILENT PAD LIVEREC pads in LIVE REC (not recorded); FUNC + pad plays at the strike's velocity and records; aftertouch, STEP REC and AUTO TRK SWITCH as designed; both kept through power-off and per GLOBAL slot. 0.4.0 (PS05) and 0.5.0 (PS07) ran on a unit, as reported; 0.5.1 differs from 0.5.0 only in the row's label.
